title: Clarinetist Bubba Green and the Amos bands
summary: Allen asks if Miller knows Bubba Green, who may have played with Amos Riley or Amos White.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: No, he's gotten too old, I guess. Maybe so. Too tired to do that now, I guess. Do you know a clarinet player named Buddy Green or Bubba Green? I met him yesterday.
He looks like he's in his 50s or 60s.
He's supposed to play with Amos Riley. Oh, well.

How about knowing if I see him yet? Cause I didn't know anybody in the Amos band but him. He's supposed to play with him. Cause he always had new men to meet my idea. Fellas coming in here from the country, you know.
Amos White maybe he played with. I can't remember. Played with Amos White or Amos Riley. I can't remember. Might have been Amos White.
Cause son, you know the bass drum player with the Eureka. Robert Lewis was telling me. Mm-hmm.
